about: Rowan's annotations, an invented case. Every participant turn in order, found by its opening words: its experiential statements, its exploratory note, its key quotes as said and the words highlighted, or empty for a turn reviewed and left empty. Then the times of the work and his PET board. make_demo.py builds the workbook, the progress file and the themes file from this and the interview CSV beside it.

es: Slipping between is and was
Eighteen months of her being everything
Living in a flat that was hers
turns.en: Tense trouble from the first lines: gone, and still in the present tense. Everything, meant both ways, as warmth and as weight.
kq: The flat was her flat. I just lived in it.

es: The best company at a lonely time
A dog leaning on his knee under the desk
Taken over before he saw it happen
turns.en: Whole days without speaking, then a dog at his knee. The taking over is only visible once it has happened.
kq: Everything had to be arranged round her.

turns.at: So I'd be up at quarter past five.
es: Walking when nobody else does
Nocturnal, and not really joking
turns.en: A timetable built round her fear of other dogs. Scream, not bark: he corrects his own word to give its size.
kq: So we went when nobody else did.

turns.at: Some of them were lovely, actually.
es: Frost, an empty field and her loops
A moment that was theirs alone
Always listening for another dog
turns.en: Joy and watchfulness in one moment. The lovely walks sit inside the listening, never apart from it.
kq: this is all right, this is ours
I never stopped listening, the whole time I had her.

turns.at: No. And I didn't notice I was doing it until after.
es: Crossing the road for a dog not there
A body still keeping watch for her
turns.en: The watchfulness outlasts her. He finds it out halfway across the road, in his body before his thinking.
kq: My body was still doing it for her.
turns.crux: My body was still doing it for her.

es: Her head finding his foot again
The note through the door, the marked frame
Not leaving her at all, for months
turns.en: Tenderness and confinement in one image, the head on the foot. Home narrows to the flat and the car.
kq: So after that I didn't leave her.

turns.at: Erm. At the time I'd have said it was fine.
es: Not feeling the loss while it happened
His sister seeing he never went out
A reason nobody argues with
turns.en: Someone else names it first. The dog as a good reason, and so nobody asks.
kq: I'd stopped saying yes to things so long ago that people had stopped asking.

es: A letter putting the tenancy in doubt
Unable to keep her or others safe
turns.en: The letter in his hand, her weight against his legs. Safety splits two ways and he leaves it split.
kq: I can't keep her safe here.

turns.at: Yeah. I've gone back and forth on which.
es: Choosing the flat, then choosing her
A life she could not do
Taking the fault as his own
turns.en: The blame moves over time, from everyone else to her life to himself. She stays blameless throughout.
kq: That wasn't her fault. That was mine.

es: Trying everything first, on the record
Exercises that never helped on the stairs
turns.en: On the record: he wants it known that he tried. The behaviourist's sentence lands before it ends.
kq: some dogs need a different life, not a different owner

es: Awful and a relief at once
Ashamed of the relief, still
Feeling he was lying to her
turns.en: A week of saying nothing. A secret kept from a dog who cannot know it, and still felt as a lie.
kq: I felt like I was lying to her.

es: Saying yes before hearing anything else
Her head in his lap, as if she knew
turns.en: The yes comes before the details. He corrects himself, she did not know, and lets the feeling stand.
kq: But it felt like she knew.

turns.at: I drove her up there myself.
es: Driving her there himself
She did not look back again
turns.en: He wants to take her himself. Not looking back is what you would want, he says, twice over.

turns.at: I sat in the car in their yard
es: Arms with nothing to hold
Not crying when he thought he would
Keeping her bowl without knowing why
turns.en: Light as in empty, the body again. The bowl is kept under the sink, out of sight and never thrown away.
kq: I just felt very light, like my arms didn't have anything to hold.

es: Still waking at quarter past five
Nothing to get up for, so lying there
Glad of the photo, then the phone face down
turns.en: The old timetable goes on without her. Good news on the screen, and the screen turned over.
kq: I still wake up at quarter past five, three months on.

es: Glad and something else with no name
Saying she is better off, every day
Needing to keep saying it
turns.en: He takes his own repetition as a sign. Unsettled, and he knows it.
kq: If it was settled I wouldn't need to say it every day, would I.

es: Not yet, without knowing what yet means
Not knowing whether he failed her
turns.en: Open, and named as open. A question he does not expect anyone to answer for him.
kq: whether I failed her or whether I did the right thing for her

turns.at: Only that she was a good dog.
es: Frightened, not a problem
One sock every morning for eighteen months
turns.en: He defends her against his own telling. He ends on the sock, small and daily.
kq: She wasn't a problem. She was frightened.
turns.crux: She wasn't a problem. She was frightened.

turns.at: No. No, I think that's everything.
